G&A Solutions Engineering (GSE) is IS&T's dedicated technology partner for Apple's general and administrative functions — including people, finance, facilities, legal, and security. The team builds and delivers integrated technology solutions that keep these functions running efficiently and securely at global scale. GSE also works closely with business teams to develop custom tools that improve productivity and bring greater automation and consistency to G&A operations across Apple.
When you engineer for People Systems, your users are Apple’s most vital asset: its People. We are seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to shape the technical strategy for People Systems with a passion for platforms where configuration is the product, and agentic workflows that redefine what's possible.
You will be working on a Platform that helps define features. Data models, rules, workflows, permissions, screens and reports are all versioned configuration, interpreted at runtime, so the people closest to a problem can change how the system behaves without waiting for a release. Hundreds of components must behave as one system. We are looking for a passionate engineer who can make that true.
We value engineers who bring both technical excellence and product thinking. You'll make the architectural calls that balance fast delivery against long-term platform health, and build systems that are scalable, secure and resilient by design rather than by retrofit.
This role requires someone who thrives on complexity but ships simplicity.
Collaboration is central to how we work. You’ll partner with product managers and cross-functional engineering teams to understand problems deeply before reaching for solutions. The best engineers here are the ones who ask “why” before “how.” If you care deeply about precision, data integrity, and crafting platforms where scale meets human empathy, come join us to do the best work of your life.
Design, build and own components of a configuration-driven platform, from design to production, hands-on, growing from well-scoped components to whole services
Make configuration safe to change: validated, versioned and previewable before release, with controlled promotion across environments and rollback
Build security, tenancy and privacy into the platform itself, so that unsafe access is impossible rather than left to caller discipline
Build event-driven services that handle high-concurrency, multi-tenant workloads reliably
Design APIs and contracts with clear versioning and compatibility checks, so consuming teams can build without coordination overhead
Help interdependent components behave as one system, respecting boundaries and contracts, and fixing issues that span components
Own correctness: write the tests that prove it, build quality gates into the delivery pipeline so every change, whether written by a person or an agent, is verified before it ships, and take part in code review
Diagnose and fix distributed-systems issues through to a root-cause fix
Operate what you ship: build observability in, deploy without downtime, and take a share of on-call
Work AI-natively: build with coding agents in an orchestrated workflow and verify their output with tests and review
Automation Development: Design and build tools to streamline development tasks and performance tuning. Integrate AI/ML capabilities into areas like intelligent configuration recommendations, workload-aware scheduling, and LLM-powered interfaces that simplify complex operator workflows
API-Driven Services: Design, build, and maintain secure, versioned microservices that expose application lifecycle operations as APIs. Ensure correctness under concurrent execution, handle partial failures gracefully, and evolve the API surface to support new capabilities without breaking existing consumers
Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD): Integrate application management automation into CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, canary rollouts, and rollback capabilities
Monitoring and Alerting: Develop and enhance monitoring, alerting, and health-check systems that give both the platform team and customers deep visibility into application health. Build self-healing mechanisms that detect and remediate known failure patterns automatically
Build agents for the AI SDLC that generate, run, triage and maintain tests, and the automation and quality gates around them
Contribute designs and reference implementations, and partner with architects and product to turn ambiguous problems into clear specs
Minimum Qualifications
8 years proven experience developing software in a professional capacity. Longer experience strongly preferred.
6 years proven experience with Java or Kotlin, including mastery in concurrency, memory management, and performance optimization techniques.
8 years proven mastery in OOP principles, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns (e.g. GoF), with a proven focus on implementing testable, maintainable, and extensible backend code.
6 years proven experience in least one modern frontend stack (such as React/Next.js) coupled with LLM feature development, utilizing the top 3 ecosystem languages: TypeScript, Python, and JavaScript.
B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent professional work experience.
Preferred Qualifications
Track record of leading software projects that span multiple, distributed teams as a tech lead (TL), while mentoring senior-level software engineers.
Hands-on experience leveraging GenAI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, Codex) to accelerate the software development lifecycle, enhance code quality, and streamline debugging and testing processes.

We are seeing a collaborative, results-oriented individual to drive audio/visual and technical production for high-visibility internal events across SWE and partner groups.
In this role, you will help shape how we reach and connect with employees, combining a passion for extraordinary event execution with a strong commitment to technical excellence. The ideal candidate combines hands-on technical production expertise with strong initiative and a drive for operational efficiency, with a focus on leveraging AI in workflow processes. Advanced proficiency with Apple productivity tools (Keynote, Numbers, Pages)

Join us, the team that serves as Apple’s nerve center: Apple Information Systems and Technology group! We are looking for Software Quality Engineers, who will work closely with other Software Engineers, Project & Product Managers, Product Designers, and other internal & external partners.
There are countless ways you can contribute here, from working on apple.com to software for digital & physical Apple Stores, from software for Apple Care to Apple-wide systems for identity, operations, recruiting, and people management, from software for Apple data centers to Apple-wide data processing & AI/ML systems.
When you join IS&T, you’ll help design and manage systems, frameworks, and apps that countless Apple customers and employees rely on every day. Together, we’ll explore all the ways to improve how Apple operates, freeing our employees to do what they do best, and crafting magical experiences for our customers.

Implement CI/CD pipeline integration to enhance automated testing execution
Analyze test results, report defects, and track issues using defect management tools
Continuously improve test automation frameworks and enhance testing efficiency
Championing quality efforts beyond test execution, including collaborating with test automation engineering teams, product management teams and engineering program teams

4+ years experience in software quality assurance testing
Experience with modern test automation frameworks such as Playwright/Selenium, Appium with Java, Typescript/JS or Python
Build and improve QE frameworks, tools, and infrastructure that increase engineering productivity
Design and implement scalable automation across UI, API, integration, and end-to-end testing.
Experience in testing Web, API, iOS/iPad OS native applications

Own the quality strategy for one or more application areas.
Develop/Adopt GenAI-powered solutions for test case generation, test automation, defect analysis, test data generation, test execution, and quality intelligence.
Establish appropriate evaluation, reliability, security, and observability practices for GenAI-powered QE solutions.

Experience in testing microservices and cloud-based applications
Evaluate and integrate AI/agentic testing tools into existing QE workflows.
Define test strategies for functional, integration, regression, performance, reliability, and production-readiness requirements.
Experience with CI/CD and integrating automated quality gates into engineering pipelines.
Understands log scanning to identify errors and root cause, with strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills.
Hands on experience with Load, Resiliency & Performance testing and tools like Jmeter/Gatling.
Experience with Testing of GenAI based applications, Security and Accessibility testing is good to have
Experience in cloud technologies such as AWS/GCP and containerisation technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes is good to have
Partner with Dev engineers, EPMs, and Business teams to identify and mitigate quality risks early.
Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with Software Engineers and Product teams.
Hands-on experience leveraging AI agents, MCP servers, and LLM-driven developer tools to accelerate test automation and engineering workflows at scale.

At Apple, we strive every single day to craft products and platforms that enrich people’s lives. Our successes are the result of skilled domain experts working in an environment that encourages creativity, collaboration, and rethinking old problems in new ways.
Retail and Marcom Engineering, an IS&T team, builds and operates the systems and experiences that connect Apple's products with its customers. The team owns the technology behind both Apple's online and physical stores and drives the interactive marketing experiences and tools that keep creative operations moving. Together, those functions deliver the technology behind every product story Apple tells and every purchase a customer makes.
As a member of the Digital Asset Management (DAM) Engineering team, you will design and develop next-generation enterprise asset platforms that manage, transform, index, and distribute massive volumes of creative and digital assets worldwide. You will sit at the intersection of enterprise software engineering, machine learning, and generative AI—infusing intelligent search, semantic understanding, auto-tagging, multimodal indexing, and AI-driven automation into foundational asset workflows. You will have the unique and rewarding opportunity to shape high-scale, mission-critical systems relied upon daily by cross-functional teams across Apple.
Our team is looking for a passionate, technically skilled software engineer who thrives in designing scalable distributed backend systems and integrating cutting-edge machine learning and generative AI capabilities. You will work autonomously within a collaborative team, partnering closely with product managers, ML practitioners, platform architects, and downstream engineering teams. We rely on your technical leadership and hands-on expertise to design resilient architectures, evolve enterprise DAM platforms, and implement robust AI/ML pipelines that deliver high impact.
Architect and Develop Backend Services: Design, implement, and maintain high-throughput,
low-latency microservices and ingestion pipelines using Java and modern distributed
architectures.
DAM Platform Engineering & Integration: Build, extend, and customize Digital Asset
Management solutions (e.g., Nuxeo, Orange Logic, or open-source frameworks) — tailoring core
document/asset models, lifecycle workflows, and storage abstractions — and integrate them
with internal systems and creative tools.
Apply ML and Generative AI to Digital Assets: Enable Natural Language Search, Embed ML
models and LLM/multimodal workflows into asset lifecycle pipelines—powering automated
tagging, image and video understanding, semantic and vector search, captioning, transcript
extraction, content summaries, metadata enrichment, and generative content workflows.
Scale and Reliability: Ensure high availability, data consistency, and fault tolerance across
distributed storage tiers, caching layers, and search engines handling petabyte-scale media.
Full Lifecycle Involvement: Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams — including DevOps
across CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments (Kubernetes/Docker), and observability
(metrics, logs, traces) — as well as Production Support and Data Services teams.
Drive Technical Excellence: Translate ambiguous requirements and business needs into clean, testable, and well-documented technical specifications and APIs.
Minimum Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related technical field, or
equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong focus on backend
systems.
Strong proficiency in Java (including modern Java features, concurrency, performance profiling,
and frameworks such as Spring Boot).
Practical experience designing and operating RESTful APIs, event-driven architectures, or
distributed streaming systems (e.g., Apache Kafka or equivalent modern message brokers).
Familiarity with database technologies (relational databases such as PostgreSQL and
search/vector stores like Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or Milvus/Pinecone).
Preferred Qualifications
Digital Asset Management Experience: Hands-on experience developing, configuring, or
extending enterprise or open-source DAM platforms or similar content repository engines.
Understanding of core computer science concepts, including algorithms, data structures,
distributed systems, and concurrent programming.
Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Alibaba Cloud).
ML & Generative AI Integration: Hands-on experience applying ML or generative AI in
production software, such as integrating machine learning inference services, large language
models, embeddings, vector databases, computer vision models, or LLM-based pipelines (e.g.,
LangChain, model serving via Triton/TorchServe, prompt engineering, or multimodal search).
Distributed Storage & Media Processing: Familiarity with cloud object storage (S3), content
delivery networks (CDNs), and media processing pipelines.
DevOps & Cloud-Native Tooling: Working familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-
code, and production telemetry (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana).
Strong analytical problem-solving skills, with enthusiasm to tackle ambiguous technical
challenges in a fast-paced environment.

Most software engineering roles hand off testing to one team and operations to another. Here you own all of it. Our job is to get teams to production quickly, on a platform that stays secure and reliable without them having to think about it.
Our charter is deliberately wide and still growing, reaching from the physical fleet in the data center to the surfaces engineering teams build against, and extending into new environments and new classes of infrastructure as Apple's needs evolve. We are a small team with outsized reach, bringing an AI-first mindset to how the platform operates and improves itself, and the best work we do takes one team's hardest problem and turns it into a capability every team inherits.
You will work with product owners, infrastructure owners, and partner engineers to turn ambiguous, high-impact problems into clean solutions. You'll own products that ETS teams depend on every day. You will also help define how AI agents work in production alongside humans, in the same codebases our engineers ship to daily.
The role mixes product engineering with hands-on integration work. You may start closer to one than the other, and you should be comfortable moving between them as the work changes.

Full-stack experience: a backend language such as Java (Spring Boot or similar) and a modern web UI framework such as React or Angular
Experience designing features with security principles (threat modeling, authentication and authorization, least privilege, secure data handling) and scalable patterns (stateless services, caching, asynchronous messaging, retries, circuit breakers, back-pressure), and explaining your trade-offs in design reviews

- Daily use of GenAI coding tools (Claude, Copilot, Codex) to speed up development, testing, and debugging

The Multimodal Intelligence Team is building the next generation of foundation models for Apple experiences. We are looking for a research scientist to advance the architectures, pre-training methods, and distillation techniques that make highly capable multimodal models practical across the Apple ecosystem.
Our research spans the full foundation-model lifecycle: model architecture, pre-training objectives, data mixtures, optimization, scaling, distillation, and evaluation. A defining challenge of our work is to develop models that combine broad intelligence with the memory, latency, energy, and privacy requirements of on-device deployment.
You will have the opportunity to shape new research directions, conduct ambitious experiments at scale, and translate successful ideas into foundation-model technologies that can reach Apple products. Where appropriate, this work may also lead to publications and the open sourcing of selected models, research artifacts, evaluations, or tools.
In this role, you will investigate fundamental questions about how multimodal foundation models should be designed, trained, and distilled.
You will develop and evaluate new model architectures, pre-training objectives, data strategies, optimization methods, and teacher–student learning techniques. Your work will explore how capabilities developed in large foundation models can be effectively transferred to smaller, more efficient models without treating distillation as an isolated downstream step.
A major focus of the role will be the co-development of frontier models and efficient models for Apple silicon and on-device intelligence. This includes designing architectures that distill effectively, studying how teacher and student models should be trained together, and developing distillation methods that preserve reasoning, multimodal understanding, instruction following, and other important capabilities under constrained model capacity.
Rather than treating deployment constraints as an afterthought, you will incorporate them into the research process—from early architecture experiments and pre-training through distillation and final model evaluation.
You may thrive in this role if you:
* Want to invent new foundation-model architectures rather than only adapt existing models.
* Enjoy combining scientific ambition with real compute, memory, latency, and energy constraints.
* Believe that small and efficient models can be a frontier research problem, not merely a compression exercise.
* Are comfortable working across model research, data, systems, and hardware boundaries.
* Care about translating research into private, useful, and deeply integrated intelligent experiences.
* Want your work to have both product impact and a presence in the broader research community.
Potential research directions include:
* Novel dense, recurrent, state-space, mixture-of-experts, and hybrid foundation-model architectures.
* Multimodal pre-training across language, images, video, audio, and sensor-derived representations.
* Compute-optimal model and data scaling, including data mixtures, curricula, tokenization, and training objectives.
* Architecture and algorithm co-design for memory-efficient and energy-efficient inference on Apple silicon.
* Offline and on-policy distillation using teacher-generated data, logits, representations, rationales, and other supervision signals.
Minimum Qualifications
Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and running large-scale pre-training experiments for large language models.
Experience with LLM pre-training topics such as model architecture, training objectives, data mixtures, tokenization, curricula, scaling, and optimization.
Strong proficiency with modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX and distributed training systems.
Experience evaluating pre-trained models across language understanding, reasoning, instruction following, or multimodal capabilities.
Strong understanding of transformer-based architectures and current approaches to efficient or scalable foundation-model training.
Master’s degree, or equivalent practical experience in machine learning, computer science, or a related technical field.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience contributing to major foundation-model pre-training efforts or leading architecture experiments that influenced a large training run.
Research contributions in model architecture, scaling laws, multimodal pre-training, optimization, efficient attention, mixture-of-experts, state-space models, or related areas.
Experience with knowledge distillation, including offline or off-policy distillation, on-policy distillation, self-distillation, sequence-level distillation, logic matching, or representation transfer.
Experience designing teacher–student training pipelines or transferring capabilities from large foundation models to smaller models.
Experience with multimodal models spanning language, vision, video, audio, or other sensor modalities.
Understanding of inference efficiency, memory hierarchy, hardware accelerators, or hardware–software co-design.
Strong publication record, influential open-source contributions, or an equivalent record of applied research impact

We are looking for a hands-on Evaluation leader to build and lead a team of applied scientists and machine learning engineers who measure the quality of a new, multi-year Apple initiative. You will join at the start as a key contributor to the evaluation function, working with other eval leaders to establish how the team knows the system is correct, relevant, and trustworthy before and after it ships. You will own specific components of the evaluation plan, including methods, datasets, and automated grading systems that turn product behavior into clear quality signals for engineering and executive leadership.
You will lead a team that designs and runs evaluation for a conversational experience that understands what people ask for, finds and ranks the right results, and allows them to complete tasks. Quality in this product spans several layers: interpreting a request correctly, retrieving and ranking the right results, composing a grounded and accurate response, and executing actions correctly through integrations with external partners. You and your team will be key contributors to the overall evaluation plan for this service and will own the evaluation methods for the layers in your area.
Within your components, you will set the technical direction for large language model (LLM) based autograders and rubrics, including rubric design, evaluation set development, validation, and calibration. You will pair these with logging and instrumentation and online experimentation, working alongside the other eval leaders who own different parts of the plan. You will build the roadmap for your components, translate the broader evaluation strategy into concrete methods and deliverables, and make sure your results turn into measurable quality gains and clear inputs to release decisions.
This is a hands-on role. You will review designs and experiments, stay close to the data, and mentor a team of scientists and engineers while you recruit and grow it. You will partner with engineering, applied machine learning, quality assurance, and program management teams, and you will present quality status, risks, and trade-offs for your areas to senior leadership. The product, its architecture, and its quality bar are still taking shape, so you will operate with significant latitude and help shape what "good" and "shippable" mean as the work evolves.
We're looking for someone with a proven track record in:
Building automated grading systems that scale to large, frequently changing datasets and using them to drive
improvements in models and product features.
Defining metrics and evaluation sets that reflect real user behavior and predict real-world quality.
Turning evaluation findings into action by partnering with engineering and applied machine learning teams to diagnose failures and ship fixes.
Contributing evaluation results to release processes as explicit quality gates.
Growing senior individual contributors and technical leads from within a team, and recruiting strong talent in competitive hiring markets
Minimum Qualifications
6+ years of experience in machine learning, data science, or machine learning evaluation, including 3+ years of
direct people management of scientists or engineers.
Track record of hiring, developing, and leading teams of applied scientists, data scientists, or machine learning
engineers.
Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-based autograders and rubrics, including rubric design, evaluation
set development, validation, and calibration.
Experience evaluating conversational AI, search, recommendation, or ranking systems, using both offline metrics
and online experimentation.
Strong command of statistics and experimental design, including A/B testing and interpreting noisy metrics.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of influencing engineers and senior leaders
Preferred Qualifications
MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent
experience.
Experience evaluating agentic or tool-use systems that take real-world actions, including multi-turn behavior,
planning, and task completion.
Experience with relevance and ranking evaluation, including graded relevance judgments and ranking metrics.
Experience with groundedness and factuality evaluation of generated responses.
Experience with logging infrastructure and instrumentation for AI product quality measurement.
Experience generating and validating synthetic evaluation data.
Experience evaluating systems that integrate with third-party partner APIs.
Experience with privacy-preserving evaluation practices.
